title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Standard for Failed Attempts, Rebooking and Storage
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery attempt fails when the delivery cannot be completed: nobody is home after the wait time, or the item cannot be brought in. Each failed attempt is recorded with its cause: customer not home, access problem, Marlowe & Finch missed the date, or item damaged on the truck.

## Standard

1. The team waits the level's customer wait time, in minutes, at the address before recording customer not home.
2. After a failed attempt the goods are held for the level's storage hold, in calendar days, for a rebooking.
3. A rebooking after a failed attempt caused by customer not home or an access problem is billed the level's redelivery fee. A rebooking after Marlowe & Finch missed the date or the item was damaged on the truck is free, and the missed date is handled under the Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery service credit rules.
4. After the level's maximum number of failed attempts, or when no rebooking is made within the storage hold, the booking is cancelled, with the cause recorded as attempts exhausted or storage hold expired respectively. The delivery charges already billed on the booking are kept, and the merchandise is refunded under the Merchandise Purchases order rules for a cancelled unit.

## Rebooking charge by cause of failure

| Cause recorded for the failed attempt | Rebooking |
|---|---|
| Customer not home | Billed the level's redelivery fee |
| Access problem | Billed the level's redelivery fee |
| Marlowe & Finch missed the date | Free |
| Item damaged on the truck | Free |

## Ending a booking after failed attempts

| What has happened | Outcome |
|---|---|
| The number of failed attempts reaches the level's maximum | Booking cancelled; cause attempts exhausted |
| No rebooking is made within the storage hold | Booking cancelled; cause storage hold expired |

In either case the delivery charges already billed are kept, and the merchandise is refunded under the order rules for a cancelled unit.

## Illustrations (hypothetical bookings at a level allowing 2 attempts)

- First attempt fails, customer not home; the customer rebooks within the storage hold. The rebooking is billed the redelivery fee.
- First attempt fails because the item was damaged on the truck; the rebooking is free.
- First attempt fails, access problem; rebooked; second attempt fails, customer not home. With 2 failed attempts the booking is cancelled for attempts exhausted, the delivery charges already billed stay on the booking, and the merchandise is refunded as a cancelled unit.
- First attempt fails, customer not home; no rebooking is made within the storage hold. The booking is cancelled for storage hold expired.
